policy.dormantExclusionRule: A symbol may leave the active coverage denominator only with explicit instrument-status evidence. Staleness alone never makes a symbol dormant.
policy.fallbackRule: Fallback may fill missing data only if its access terms permit automated use and its session/price checks pass.
policy.safety: Data-source status never enables automatic execution.

sources.notes: ASTRA consumes the user's canonical repository and validates atomic session/fingerprint alignment before publishing.

sources.currentUse: Provenance label on rows already present in the canonical upstream
sources.notes: ASTRA WP4 does not add a new direct scraper.

sources.complianceReason: Yahoo Terms prohibit automated collection from the Services without express prior permission. WP4 therefore does not enable automated Yahoo verification.
